pilot.purpose: Test V3.2-informed emotion and delivery direction, connected-utterance grouping, natural Mongolian intelligibility, and timing before expanding to the full 10-minute Vivienne track.
pilot.voice_settings: Use existing saved voice settings unchanged; no numerical overrides.

clips.tts_text: Гурав дахь аяганы амт ялзарсан зүйл шиг байлаа.
clips.delivery_direction: Clear, reflective inner voice. Keep the texture neutral and measured; convey the unpleasant realization subtly, without theatrical disgust.
Measured inner voice with slight breathiness and restrained panic. Keep every Mongolian word clear; do not whisper or overact.

clips.tts_text: Чонын хор аль хэдийн цээжинд минь хүрчээ.
clips.delivery_direction: Restrained strained inner voice reflecting physical pain. Keep pace measured and articulation clean; no exaggerated gasping.

clips.tts_text: Лусиан орны хөлд зогсоод амьсгал хураахыг минь харж байлаа.
clips.delivery_direction: Quiet resentment in Vivienne's inner narration. One connected sentence across both subtitle cues; avoid an artificial pause at the cue boundary.

clips.tts_text: Би юм хэлэхийг оролдсон ч амнаас минь ганц ч үг гарсангүй.
clips.delivery_direction: One connected breathless inner thought. Preserve a natural slight hesitation after 'ч' if needed, but do not split it into two unrelated statements.
Bitter inner reflection, restrained and matter-of-fact. Avoid audible anger; keep the line compact and natural.
User-confirmed ordinary, natural Vivienne inner voice. No added dramatic anger, shouting, or strained acting.
User-confirmed ordinary, natural Vivienne inner voice. Do not inject rage or theatrical intensity despite the subtitle wording.

clips.tts_text: Гэвч миний бие аль хэдийн амьгүй болж байв.
clips.delivery_direction: User-confirmed ordinary, natural Vivienne inner voice. Keep the delivery calm and intelligible; do not add defeated sadness or breathless drama.

clips.tts_text: Тэр хоосон аягыг ширээн дээр тавив.
clips.delivery_direction: Matter-of-fact narration in Vivienne's normal voice. Measured, clear, and unforced.
Soft, fading inner voice with a slightly slower pace. Keep the words understandable; avoid a melodramatic fade or trailing off too early.
Quiet, flat, concise delivery. Preserve a natural sentence ending; do not force a dramatic whisper.

clips.tts_text: Би нүдээ нээхэд ээжийнхээ Коулдвелл эдлэн дэх зочны өрөөнд байлаа.
clips.delivery_direction: A sudden but natural awakening: mild surprise and uncertainty, with a slight lift in energy. Keep the Mongolian place name clear and do not overplay shock.
